draft.subject: Inquiry on the Embedded and Low Level Software Openings | Justin Mascarenhas
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I am writing about the embedded and low level software engineering openings at Interclypse. The posting covers several openings rather than one team, so I am writing to a few people directly to find where the fit actually is.

My background is embedded and systems software. I wrote monitoring firmware for a microcontroller at the bare metal level that held a steady update rate in a very small memory footprint, and I have run concurrent firmware tasks under an RTOS. For my graduate capstone I built a voice controlled robotic arm as a distributed system and worked through the integration failures across it until it ran reliably, including deploying the Linux side as a service that recovered on its own.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
